Six call sites use `graph::load(...)`, all invisible to carto's own resolver since Rust's module-qualified calls (`graph::load()`) are a known extraction gap — that's exactly what `root_uncaptured_inbound_calls: 6` was flagging, and a grep confirms it.

If `graph::load`'s signature changes, update:

- **`crates/carto-core/src/graph/load.rs:23-78`** — the definition itself
- **`crates/carto-cli/src/where_cmd.rs:47`**
- **`crates/carto-cli/src/deps_cmd.rs:72`**
- **`crates/carto-cli/src/map_cmd.rs:70`**
- **`crates/carto-mcp/src/tools/where_tool.rs:43`**
- **`crates/carto-mcp/src/tools/deps_tool.rs:66`**
- **`crates/carto-mcp/src/tools/map_tool.rs:40`**

All six call sites follow the same pattern (`graph::load(&...out_root)?` / `.map_err(...)`), which lines up with the CLI/MCP parity noted in CLAUDE.md — each CLI subcommand and its MCP tool counterpart both call the same core function.
